display_name: Thailand / Official Law Library (PRD, Government of Thailand)
description: Thai laws in the official legal library of the Public Relations Department of the Government of Thailand (law.prd.go.th). Official government source. The Royal Gazette portal (ratchakitcha.soc.go.th) is Cloudflare-walled; law.prd.go.th serves the same Acts as PDFs. Identifier is the full official PDF URL. Connector downloads the PDF and extracts its Thai text layer. Verified 2026-09-07 on the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (2019).
